backup-job.theLastObservationIsStaleCurr: The last observation is stale; current job status is unavailable.
backup-job.readHelp: The original backup job could not be read. Use Retry original status read here; this observes the same job and does not repeat creation or deletion.
backup-job.failedHelp: This creation attempt failed and cannot be replayed by observation. Check storage space and write permissions on the original server; create a new backup explicitly when ready.
backup-job.cleanupHelp: The original cleanup is unsettled. Check storage access on the original server, then reread this same job here. Do not submit a replacement deletion or infer removal from resource absence.
backup-job.mismatchHelp: The returned status does not match the original backup job. Retry its original status read here. Creation, removal and cleanup remain unconfirmed.
